title: Center for Taiwan International Relations, CTIR 台灣國際關係中心
content_html: The Center for Taiwan International Relations (CTIR) was formally established on December 15, 1988, in Washington, D.C. Its core purposes include researching and promoting Taiwan’s independent sovereignty and equal standing in the international community, as well as developing diplomatic relations with both developing and advanced nations. CTIR also aims to build a think tank to cultivate diplomatic talent among Taiwanese at home and abroad, and to facilitate exchanges between Taiwan’s social movement organizations and counterpart groups in other countries.
